scenarios: Repository: ImmuneSpace. Context: The Human Immunology Project Consortium (HIPC) is expanding to include new multi-omics data types beyond transcriptomics. Challenge: Develop a training plan to onboard new consortium sites on data harmonization protocols and standardized metadata submission to ensure interoperability across the expanded data landscape.

Repository: IEDB (Immune Epitope Database). Context: New machine learning-based epitope prediction tools have been integrated into the portal. Challenge: Create an outreach strategy targeting vaccine developers in the pharmaceutical industry to demonstrate tool utility and encourage contribution of proprietary validation data.

Repository: ImmPort. Context: The repository manages data from NIAID-funded clinical trials. Challenge: Design a training workshop series for Principal Investigators focused on FAIR metadata standards for clinical data deposition, ensuring compliance with NIAID data sharing policies prior to publication.

Repository: VEuPathDB. Context: This resource hosts genomic data for eukaryotic pathogens affecting global health. Challenge: Formulate a capacity-building outreach plan for researchers in endemic low-resource regions, focusing on remote training sessions for data mining and genomic analysis tools.

Repository: Single-Cell Immunology Atlas. Context: A emerging repository dedicated to high-dimensional single-cell immune profiling. Challenge: Produce documentation and video tutorials addressing the complex metadata annotation required for single-cell datasets to facilitate reuse by computational biologists.

Repository: NIAID Proteomics Data Archive. Context: Centralizes mass spectrometry data from infectious disease research. Challenge: Establish a best practices guide and webinar series for wet-lab researchers on formatting raw proteomics data for public deposition to maximize findability and accessibility.

Repository: NIAID Central Data Archive. Context: A general-purpose repository for various NIAID grant outputs. Challenge: Implement a clear citation policy and tracking mechanism to communicate to users how to properly cite datasets in publications, aiming to improve impact metrics for funding reports.

Repository: Flow Cytometry Repository. Context: Stores high-dimensional flow and mass cytometry data. Challenge: Develop training materials focused on standardizing gating strategy descriptions and submission templates to ensure data is interpretable and reusable by external immunologists.

Repository: Microbiome Data Center. Context: Hosts host-pathogen microbiome interaction data. Challenge: Create a community engagement strategy to encourage data sharing among private industry partners who may be hesitant due to proprietary concerns, emphasizing anonymization and benefit sharing.

Repository: Structural Immunology DB. Context: Focuses on 3D models of immune receptors and antigens. Challenge: Design outreach materials for structural biologists regarding 3D model deposition standards and training on using integrated visualization tools for epitope mapping.

Repository: Pediatric Immunology Data Hub. Context: Manages sensitive immunological data from pediatric cohorts. Challenge: Construct a training plan focused on privacy-preserving data access protocols and ethical compliance requirements for researchers requesting access to sensitive datasets.

Repository: NIAID Data Federation Portal. Context: An interoperable layer connecting ImmPort, IEDB, and ImmuneSpace. Challenge: Develop a user guide and training workshop series teaching researchers how to perform cross-repository queries to integrate clinical, epitope, and profiling data seamlessly.
